description: Make an AI Legacy Story: a 3D animated film of the user's life, business or family story, told in on-screen dialogue, with the user's real photos at the end. It spends credits from the user's MakeViral account (a scene that fails gives its credits back) and takes about 10-15 minutes: this call returns at once, then call get_legacy_story with wait true. Two ways: 1) your own script as `draft` (write it with legacy_story_guide's rules; MakeViral then only makes the film and charges no writer), or 2) only the `story` text, and MakeViral writes the script. Before calling: check it with check_legacy_story, tell the user the price in credits, and with photos ask the user to confirm the people in them are them or agreed, and that no one is a child. Photos: `references` are the photos the characters and places are drawn from (a person, a logo, a screenshot), each with the id the script uses, and its photo as photoUrl or as the next chat file in referencePhotos. `proofPhotos` / `proofPhotoUrls` are the real photos the film ends on. Calling again with the same input within 10 minutes returns the first story.

captions.description: Big burned-in captions of the lines. Default big.

draft.description: Your own script, in the shape legacy_story_guide shows: title, characters, places, blocks (scenes of shots), proofLines.

line.description: At most 12 words, in the story language

speaker.description: Character key of the one who talks (in the shot)

look.description: English: age, build, hair, face, clothes, one signature detail

refId.description: The id of a person reference

sameAs.description: The key of the main character this is a younger or older version of

proofLines.description: One short ALL CAPS line per proof photo

language.description: Language of the spoken lines. Default en.

model.description: Video model. Default minimax-h3 (sharpest, keeps each voice).

music.description: Music bed. Default legacy (dark trap beat, big lift at the end).

photosConsent.description: Needed with photos: true only after the user confirmed everyone in them is the user or agreed, and no one is a child

proofPhotoUrls.description: Real photos the film ends on, as public https links

proofPhotos.description: Real photos the film ends on, attached in the chat

quality.description: Size; must be one the model offers (legacy_story_guide). Default: the model's default (H3: 768p).

referencePhotos.description: The reference photos attached in the chat, in the order of the references without a photoUrl

id.description: Short id the script uses, e.g. r1 (a character's refId, a place's refIds)

kind.description: person = becomes a character; logo / screenshot = shown in a place

name.description: The name the story uses, e.g. 'Grandpa Ali', 'Acme logo'

note.description: A short note, e.g. 'me at 30', 'our first office'

photoUrl.description: Public https link to the photo (else the next file of referencePhotos)

requestId.description: Optional id (8-64 letters, digits, - or _). The same id never charges twice.

seconds.description: Target length of the animated part. Default 60. With your own script, its scenes set the length.

story.description: The story in the user's own words: who, where, the turning points, the real names, numbers and years

name: start_legacy_story
title: Make a legacy story
